cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import re
PARSE_RE = re.compile(r'''({{|}}|{\w*(?:(?:\.\w+)|(?:\[[^\]]+\]))*(?::[^}]+)?})''')

# Let's check more edge cases
test_cases = [
    '{',           # Just open brace
    '}',           # Just close brace
    '{{',          # Escaped open
    '}}',          # Escaped close
    '{{{',         # What happens here?
    '{a.b}',       # Dotted name
    '{a[0]}',      # Indexed access
    '{a.b[0]}',    # Both
    '{',           # Single open
]

for tc in test_cases:
    parts = PARSE_RE.split(tc)
    print(f'{tc!r:20} -> {parts}')
"
